question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is '**ethics**' (option 4).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the foundation of good conduct in life, which aligns with the principles of ethics and morality.
 
• The word "ethics" is the most appropriate choice as it refers to the moral principles that govern behavior, fitting the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**evil**,” "**boundaries**,” and "**unconscientiousness**”) do not fit the context of building good conduct on a moral foundation.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We should remember that all religions (1) preach__ good conduct in life, the foundation of which should rest on (2) __ethics__. Without the basis of morality, philosophy would remain mere polemics, and religion would be (3) __fruitless__ and vain. Nobody can say that he is religious unless he is (4) __moral__ and unselfish. It is realised that by constant endeavour through thought, word and deed, one could (5) __achieve__ absolute peace of mind.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Evil**: This does not fit the context of establishing a foundation for good conduct.
 
• **Boundaries**: This does not fit the context of establishing a moral foundation.
 
• **Unconscientiousness**: This is not related to the concept of morality or ethics.
